[{"node":"loopar_scheduled_jobs_menu_content","element":"menu_content","data":{"key":"loopar_scheduled_jobs_menu_content","id":"loopar_scheduled_jobs_menu_content","name":"loopar_scheduled_jobs_menu_content"},"elements":[{"node":"jobs-overview","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Overview","key":"jobs-overview","id":"jobs-overview","name":"jobs-overview","value":"# Scheduled Jobs

Apps declare recurring work — reminders, cleanups, syncs, nightly reports — in one file, and the core runs it for every tenant that has the app installed.

```javascript
// apps/<app>/jobs.js
export default [
  {
    name: "document-expiry",
    label: "Document expiry alerts",
    schedule: { every: "daily", at: "06:00" },
    run: async () => {
      // runs inside the tenant: loopar.* is that tenant's
      const expiring = await loopar.db.getAll("Document", ["name"], { status: "Expiring" });
      // ...
      return `${expiring.length} alerts sent`;   // shown in the job log
    },
  },
  {
    name: "sync",
    label: "Hourly sync",
    schedule: { every: "hourly", minute: 15 },
    run: async () => { /* ... */ },
  },
];
```

| `schedule` | Meaning |
|------------|---------|
| `{ every: "hourly", minute: 15 }` | Every hour at :15 |
| `{ every: "daily", at: "06:00" }` | Every day at 06:00 |
| `{ every: "weekly", on: "mon", at: "05:00" }` | Every Monday at 05:00 |

Times are the **server's local time**.
"}},{"node":"jobs-runtime","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"How Jobs Run","key":"jobs-runtime","id":"jobs-runtime","name":"jobs-runtime","value":"## How Jobs Run

- The scheduler ticks **every minute** inside the core.
- Each job runs **in its tenant's context** and only for tenants where its app is **installed**.
- A job never runs twice at the same time for the same tenant.
- Only tenants that are **on** and already loaded by the core are visited — the scheduler never boots a tenant by itself. A run missed while a tenant was down happens on the first tick after its next request.
- Whatever `run()` returns (a string, or anything JSON-serializable) is stored as the result; a thrown error marks the run **Failed** with its message.

Set `LOOPAR_SCHEDULER=off` to disable the scheduler for a process (useful when running scripts).

## The Scheduled Job Entity

Each tenant job gets a **Scheduled Job** record (`<app>.<name>`), created automatically the first time:

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| **Enabled** | Switch a job off for this tenant |
| **Schedule** | Readable schedule ("daily at 06:00") — change it in `jobs.js`; the next run is recomputed |
| **Next run** / **Last run** | When |
| **Status** | Success, Failed or Running |
| **Duration (ms)** / **Result** | Of the last run |

Open a job and click **Run now** to run it immediately.

The core app ships one job itself: **Backups** (hourly check that runs scheduled backups when they are due).
